summary.text: Crystal Sedillo is the Democratic candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican incumbent A.J. Louderback.
She won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary over David Steves, and her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as activist.

paragraphs.text: Crystal Sedillo graduated from Van Vleck High School, earned an associate degree from Wharton County Junior College in 2022 and received a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University-Victoria in 2026.

In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response, her campaign described her as a lifelong Texan who was born in Wharton County and raised in Matagorda County, with a bachelor's degree in communication and four years of work in education.
The response listed affordable housing, accessible health care, quality public education and economic opportunity among her policy focuses.
